evidence.reason: The finalization lookup at line 839 filters PRs only by branch (`--head branch`) requesting `number,url,state`, never the head commit. Lines 840-843 then accept a singleton and unconditionally set `record['fix_pr'] = pr`, and lines 844-847 enroll that PR via `c.new_item(... kind='open' ... why='verified repair fix PR')`. Nothing compares the returned PR's head SHA to the prepared publication commit, so a sole PR on the branch whose head is unrelated is recorded and enrolled. This matches the finding's allegation; the finding's cited lines 817-818 are stale (they now write the verdict body/fix-pr.md path), but the same branch-only lookup and unconditional recording persist at 839-843. Requesting `headRefOid` and applying the same head identity check used by the recovery path is the minimal fix.
